chapter_seo_title: Diancai Immortal Faces the Six-Nine Tribulation: A Xianxia Tragedy
chapter_meta_description: Diancai Immortal begins his Heavenly Tribulation, armed with top-grade Immortal swords. What starts as a triumphant ascent becomes a desperate struggle for survival against a cruel, seemingly impossible Six-Nine Tribulation.
og_description: Watch a Sword Immortal's desperate fight for immortality against a sky that refuses to let him pass.
twitter_title: Six-Nine Tribulation: The Heavens Show No Mercy!
twitter_description: Diancai's hope is shattered as a Six-Nine Tribulation appears. A brutal Xianxia tragedy unfolds.

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivator who has successfully reached the 'Return to Vacuity' stage in Ki Refining but is awaiting their Heavenly Tribulation to become a full Celestial Immortal.
The highest conventional grade of magical treasure in the Grand Xia world, capable of drastically increasing a cultivator's combat and defensive power.
A classic sword formation based on the Daoist concept of Heaven, Earth, and Man, used to enhance the power and stability of a group of flying swords.
A sword formation based on the interplay of the five fundamental elements (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth), creating a stable and powerful defensive or offensive array.
The foundational energy core of an Earth Immortal's soul, formed after a successful Primal-to-Earth-Immortal breakthrough; burning it is a suicidal forbidden technique.
A cultivation art that forcibly burns a cultivator's vitality or foundational energy for a temporary, massive power boost, often at the cost of lifespan or permanent cultivation damage.
A Heavenly Tribulation class consisting of six sets of nine bolts (54 bolts total); far more deadly than the standard Four-Nine Tribulation and extremely rare for an ordinary Earth Immortal.
The oldest Loose Immortal of the Black-White College, a slovenly-looking senior who failed his own tribulation and acts as Diancai Immortal's mentor and concerned watcher.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Heavenly Tribulation in Xianxia?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a mandatory life-or-death test of lightning strikes sent by the universe itself that every Ki Refiner must survive to ascend from an Earth Immortal to a Celestial Immortal; it comes in sets of nine bolts of increasing power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Six-Nine Tribulation so unfair for Diancai Immortal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A Six-Nine Tribulation (54 bolts) is a death sentence normally only faced by monstrous geniuses or disciples of supreme Daofathers, and it appears for him without any reason, suggesting the heavens are simply being cruel.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Diancai block the forty-fifth bolt?
cultural_notes_faq.a: After his main sword formation failed, he used a forbidden technique to burn his own life-force, and at the last second deployed a second set of five flying swords to intercept the residual lightning, but he was badly wounded in the process.
